annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act prescribes obligations of the States, aviation business operators, personnel, etc., including aircraft owners, air operators, aviation personnel and persons operating aircraft.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the obligations of the States, aviation business operators, personnel, etc., and other matters in accordance with standards adopted and methods recommended by the Convention on International Civil Aviation
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force 6 months after the date of its promulgation; provided, the amended provisions of Article 6-2 shall enter into force 3 months after the date of its promulgation
annotation.robot_provision_quote: "Ultra-light vehicle" means powered flying machines, hang gliders, paragliders, hot air balloons, unmanned aerial vehicles, etc.
